flows.title: View campaign performance
steps: Click the Campaigns drop down in the section menu.
On the Campaigns page, click on the campaign that you would like to view.
Click Add filter to view specific filtered data about your campaign.
Update the date dropdown menu to reflect the amount of data you would like to view. The default Campaigns view shows the last 30 days of performance.

flows.title: Download a performance report
steps: Click the Campaigns drop down in the section menu, then click Ad groups if you want ad group data.
Format the data on the page the way you want it.
Click the download button above the table.
Select your download type from the dropdown menu: Excel .csv, .csv, .tsv, .pdf, .xlsx, .xml, or Google Sheets.
When the report is finished, you will receive a Downloading report notification.
